vars.HE: the anime young man from image 1 (same face, short messy black hair with fringe, narrow dark brown eyes, calm gentle expression)

framing.close: close-up on his face and the microphone

perform_ref: Redraw image 2 as an anime film still. Replace the real man in image 2 with {HE}, {COAT}. Keep exactly the pose, head angle, eyes, mouth shape, the hands holding the handheld microphone and the framing of image 2. Remove the tablet, the music stand, the earphones and all text. Background: a small dim stage, {framing}. Lighting: {light}.
perform_motion: an anime young man in a navy coat and grey scarf sings into a handheld microphone with a quiet, melancholic sorrow in his face, brows slightly drawn together, small dim stage, black grand piano, {light}, anime cel shading
expression_edit: Edit image 1. Keep everything exactly the same: composition, framing, pose, hands and exactly what they hold (never add an object such as a microphone), outfit, hair, lighting, colors, background and anime style, and keep his eyes open or closed exactly as they are. Only change the young man's facial expression to be more melancholic: inner ends of the eyebrows slightly raised and drawn together, heavy downcast eyelids, a quiet lonely sorrow in his face, lips gently pressed. Subtle, restrained sadness held inside: dry eyes, no tears, not crying.
face_mood: his face stays quietly melancholic and lonely, dry eyes, restrained

cover: Key visual for an anime music video: {HE}, {COAT}, stands on a vast frozen bay at night under a huge green and violet aurora, three-quarter view from the front-right, looking up at the sky with a quiet, restrained melancholy, dry eyes, light snow falling, his scarf moving in the wind. He stands in the right third of the frame; the left half is calm open sky and ice with no objects, leaving space for a title. Cinematic wide shot, deep navy and teal palette with the aurora glow on his face.
